name: Numbers and Letters - Music and Melody
summary:
Step into a grand virtual concert hall and embark on a musical journey with Numbers and Letters - Music & Melody! 

This engaging game transforms learning and playing music into an immersive, interactive adventure.

"Hear It, Play It, Master It" as you explore distinct game modes guided by a cast of colourful, animated letter characters.

MAIN FEATURES:

• Ear Training Mode: Sharpen your musical ear! Listen to notes played and correctly identify them with the help of animated letter friends on the VR theatr
